mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressures that typically lead to monetary tightening, which in turn increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profitability, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPI YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, which often precedes an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS declines for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening supply-side activity, which boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 50% of instances where INDPRO increases > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, which typically leads to increased liquidity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% within a month signals a strengthening labor market, which often precedes economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 50% of instances where UNRATE decreases > 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% in the same period, it signals a strong demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% MoM and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% MoM
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of instances where HOUST increases > 5% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: When the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) increases by more than 1% month-over-month and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1%, it signals a favorable supply-side environment with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with strong supply-side
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 50% of instances where INDPRO increases > 1% and FEDFUNDS < 1%.
